_README: THIS IS A PLACEHOLDER — NOT A REAL google-services.json
To enable push notifications, follow these 4 steps:
STEP 2: Create a project (or select existing) → Add Android App
STEP 3: Download the real google-services.json from Firebase Console
Project Settings → Your Apps → Android app → Download
STEP 4: Replace THIS file with the downloaded google-services.json
Location: app/google-services.json  (same folder as this file)
STEP 5: In config.php, add your FCM Server Key:
Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging → Server key
The app will build and run WITHOUT this file during development.
Firebase-specific features (push notifications) will simply be skipped.
